title: Slides
lead: Maintain published collections for banners, carousels, products and testimonials while templates own the visual structure.

sections.title: Build a collection
steps: Open Slides → New collection. Enter a name and choose the content type, for example a banner collection.
Add items with image, alternative text, title, text, link and the other fields offered for that content type. Choose public files from Images; upload new files in Images first.
Arrange item order and enable only finished items. Save the collection, then use Edit from Overview for subsequent changes.

sections.title: Assign and insert
steps: Choose a supported template location, presentation type and optional page filter in the editor. Configure autoplay and interval only when desired, then save the published state.
Choose a location discovered from the active template manifest and publish the collection. A location must accept the collection content type.
Use a typed page block, a legacy Slides marker or the shared component service. The modern service provides published item data to the chosen registered component format.

sections.title: Motion and recovery
steps: Autoplay starts disabled. When enabled, use a suitable interval and template controls that support pause, keyboard navigation and reduced motion.
History and Trash preserve recovery. Missing template locations produce administrative warnings without deleting assignments.

sections.title: Raw slide collections
steps: slides:data(key: active-template location key) returns name, contentType, type, autoplay, interval and items: id, title, text, image, alt, href, label, attribution, price. Only live published collections and enabled matching items are returned. Template/filter rules still apply. slides:location remains compatible with existing card partials.

Bind slides:data as promotion. Example: {{#promotion.items}}{{/promotion.items}}. The plugin supplies data; the template supplies accessible carousel controls, CSS and JavaScript. No script may be authored inside the HTML editor.
